title: Léa prend le métro
summary_en: Léa buys a ticket, asks a kind lady for help, and takes the yellow line to a big park.

sentences.en: She is looking for the yellow line.

sentences.fr: Une dame est à côté de Léa.
sentences.en: A lady is next to Léa.

sentences.fr: « Excusez-moi, madame. Où est la ligne jaune ? »
sentences.en: “Excuse me, madam. Where is the yellow line?”
“Over there, on the right!” she says.
At the station, she gets out.

sentences.fr: Un grand parc est devant elle.
sentences.en: A big park is in front of her.

sentences.fr: Dans le parc, il y a des arbres et des fleurs.
sentences.en: In the park, there are trees and flowers.

sentences.fr: Léa sourit : elle aime ce pays !
sentences.en: Léa smiles: she loves this country!
